defect_classes.violated_invariant: a publication is parented by the state it was decided on (CONTRACT 9.4.2)
a provider answer applies only to the question that asked it; events only in legal states
variants: refused renewal swapped token (third review, low)
defect_classes.reviewer_evidence: closure-review-DC-002-004 (OPEN), closure-review-2 (OPEN: A), closure-review-3 (A CLOSED; low residual fixed in 63b2232, not re-reviewed)

defect_classes.violated_invariant: after the ref update is sent, no failure is reported as not written
an absent or advisory provider field never gates or grants
reads of mutable state are never answered from a cache
variants: nonce repeated across page loads (shared cache)
reload answered by a lagging replica (third review, medium)
defect_classes.reviewer_evidence: live runs 39980845597 (diagnostics), 39982330584, 39986660673, 39990408889 PASS; closure-review-2 (CLOSED); closure-review-3 (OPEN: reload), fixed in 63b2232, not re-reviewed

defect_classes.violated_invariant: a failed framework download ends the start promptly with recovery (WASM-LOAD-005)
variants: first fix failed starts the loader would have recovered (third review, medium)
